media.alt_text:
The Biden-Harris Administration’s Top Climate Accomplishments
- Signed into law the largest climate investment in history
- Established a whole-of-government strategy to tackle methane emissions
- Launched the American Climate Corps
- Advancing the most ambitious environmental justice agenda in history
- Protected 26 million acres of lands and waters
- Canceled remaining oil and gas leases in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge
- Signed an Executive Order that sets an ambitious target to make half of all new vehicles sold in 2030 zero-emissions
- Proposed carbon pollution standards for coal and gas-fired power plant emissions
- Accelerated permitting of clean energy projects
- Rallied world leaders to raise global climate ambition
- Invoked the Defense Production Act to increase domestic production of key clean energy technologies
